task: P82W2-N09 multi-rate contact integration (MTS) and time-step stability gate (TensorDEM)

depends_on: tensordem.granular2d.engine (m5524 contact laws, used as the shipped baseline and as the state preparation)

time_step_contract.definition: ratio = dt/dt_c; substeps = ceil(ratio/margin); status ok if ratio<=margin, subcycle if margin<ratio<0.5, fail if ratio>=0.5

a_restitution.statement: single Hertz impact, e = 0.5 and 0.9, dt/dt_c in {0.02,0.05,0.1,0.2}, contact sub-cycling on
a_restitution.metric: |e_measured/e_reference - 1| against a converged (dt/t_c = 5e-4) solve of the same contact law

b_ledger.statement: undamped, frictionless, doubly periodic assembly, 1e5 coarse steps, hierarchy 100:1 on 10 % of disks
b_ledger.notes: the same gate margins (outer = fast = 0.05) are used for the single-rate control so the comparison isolates the rate split

c_jamming.statement: mu = 0.5 frictional jamming, N = 256, 100:1 stiffness skeleton on 10 % of disks; identical prepared state and pressure ladder
metrics: wall clock ratio >= 2x versus the single-rate baseline
|dphi_J| <= 0.5 % between the multi-rate and single-rate runs
phi_J within 0.5 % of the W4-P1 servo result (shipped jamming_density_isotropic)

d_tightness.statement: dt/dt_c = 0.5 must be rejected by the gate and must fail detectably when forced
metrics: forced restitution error > 10 % or energy gain > 10 %

e_shards.statement: the stage-A case matrix evaluated in 1 / 2 / 4 separate processes
metrics: values identical (bitwise) or a stated floating-point bound inside the tolerance

honest_fail_policy: a criterion that fails is reported as FAIL with the measured number and the diagnosis; nothing is overwritten or re-tuned after the fact
falsifiable_predictions: freezing the soft contact force on the coarse step (classic RESPA on contact) keeps the energy ledger within 1 % -- tested in the ablation stage, expected to FAIL
the multi-rate solver reproduces phi_J within 0.5 % of the shipped single-rate engine on the same prepared state
